viewing_check: Measure the length, width and thickness of each board. Confirm it is genuine Huon pine (golden colour, strong scent, fine pin knots) and not celery-top, king billy or other pine, and check splits and bark inclusion. Check for any figure (birdseye, curl) which would lift value.
